description: This file defines a JavaScript module that provides a client class for interacting with metrics API endpoints. It includes functions for resolving base URLs, joining URL segments, and a class `MetricsClient` with methods to fetch current metrics, supporting conditional GET requests using etag and last-modified headers.

classes.name: MetricsClient
classes.description: A lightweight API client class for fetching metrics data from backend endpoints, supporting conditional requests with ETag and Last-Modified headers.

methods.name: resolveApiBaseUrl()
methods.description: Determines and normalizes the base URL for the API by checking environment variables and trimming trailing slashes.

methods.name: joinUrl(base, path)
methods.description: Concatenates a base URL and a path segment, handling relative paths and ensuring correct URL formatting.

methods.name: fetchCurrentMetrics({ includePerStream = false, etag = null, lastModified = null, signal } = {})
methods.description: Fetches the current metrics snapshot from the API, optionally using conditional headers for caching, and parses the response with error handling.

ctags.name: fetchCurrentMetrics
ctags.pattern: /^  async fetchCurrentMetrics({ includePerStream = false, etag = null, lastModified = null, signal/
ctags.signature: ({ includePerStream = false, etag = null, lastModified = null, signal } = {})
